title: Conidial production from M. fijiensis mycelium
author: Leticia LPE Peraza Echeverría
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.sgmebu6

steps.title: Prepare agar-agar solution
steps.instruction: Add agar‑agar (amount unspecified) per litre, mix with 1 L distilled water for 15 min, measure pH and adjust to pH 6, then sterilize at 1 atm and 120 °C for 15 min.

substeps.instruction: Add agar‑agar to distilled water (1 L).
Mix for 15 min.
Measure pH and adjust to 6.
Sterilize at 1 atm, 120 °C, 15 min.

steps.title: Dispense V8 sporulation medium
steps.instruction: Pour 25 mL of V8 sporulation medium into each Petri dish, then incubate for 3 days to check for contamination before use.

substeps.instruction: Add 25 mL V8 medium to each dish.
Wait 3 days and verify no contamination.

steps.title: Create ground mycelium suspension
steps.instruction: In a laminar flow cabinet, cut 1 cm² of mycelium, place it in a mortar, add 2.5 mL sterile distilled water, grind to a non‑pasty liquid, dispense 2.5 mL onto each V8 plate, spread in circles until the plate is fully covered, let dry 20 min, then seal with a KleenPack.

substeps.instruction: Cut 1 cm² mycelium.
Add 2.5 mL sterile distilled water in mortar.
Grind to a non‑pasty consistency.
Pour 2.5 mL suspension onto each V8 plate.
Spread to cover entire plate.
Dry for 20 min.
Seal with KleenPack.

steps.title: Incubate plates for sporulation
steps.instruction: Place the sealed plates at 20 °C under continuous cool‑white fluorescent and black light (GE 15 W/18) for 5 days (first harvest) followed by an additional 3 days (second harvest) on the same batch of plates.

substeps.instruction: Set temperature to 20 °C.
Provide continuous cool‑white fluorescent and black light (GE 15 W/18).
Incubate 5 days for first harvest.
Incubate further 3 days for second harvest.

steps.title: Harvest conidia from plates
steps.instruction: In a laminar flow cabinet, add 2400 µL of grenetine (1%) to each V8 plate, sweep gently with a camel brush, tilt the plate and use a micropipette to wash the mycelium with the same suspension, then collect all suspension into a 50 mL Falcon tube (suspension should appear cloudy).

substeps.instruction: Add 2400 µL grenetine (1%) to each plate.
Sweep gently with camel brush.
Tilt plate and wash mycelium with suspension using micropipette.
Transfer all suspension to a 50 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Count and adjust conidia concentration
steps.instruction: Take a sample of the harvested suspension, optionally dilute 1:10, count conidia using a Sedgwick‑Rafter or Neubauer chamber, calculate concentration with spores/mL = ΣN × 1000 mm³ × dilution factor / (A × D × F) where A = 1 mm², D = 1 mm, F = 25, adjust the original suspension to 200 conidia µL⁻¹, and store at 4 °C if not used immediately.

substeps.instruction: Sample suspension (dilute 1:10 if needed).
Count conidia with Sedgwick‑Rafter or Neubauer chamber.
Calculate concentration using the provided formula.
Adjust original suspension to 200 conidia/µL.
Store at 4 °C if not used immediately.
